headline: Officials Investigate Excess Ethanol Content In Regional Fuel Supplies
seoTitle: Probe Into Excess Ethanol In Regional Fuel
metaDescription: Authorities in Karnataka and Kerala are testing fuel samples after reports found ethanol levels exceeding the standard 20 percent blend in E20 petrol.
aiSummaryBullets: Government agencies in Karnataka and Kerala have begun testing petrol samples at various retail outlets following reports of high ethanol concentrations.
Laboratory analysis in Karnataka identified instances where ethanol blending in E20 fuel reached levels as high as 31 percent.
Karnataka officials are calling for penalties against oil marketing companies and the establishment of a compensation fund for affected vehicle owners.
aiContextParagraph: Government authorities in India have launched coordinated inspections of fuel stations following allegations of improper ethanol blending in E20 petrol. In Karnataka, the state government initiated testing across 67 locations after receiving complaints from consumers regarding fuel quality. Preliminary lab results in the region indicated that some samples contained ethanol concentrations significantly higher than the mandated 20 percent limit, with reports suggesting levels reached up to 31 percent. In response, the Karnataka Minister for Food, Civil Supplies and Consumer Affairs has requested that oil marketing companies be held accountable for the discrepancies and proposed a compensation mechanism for vehicle owners impacted by the fuel quality. The issue has expanded geographically, as officials in Kerala have commenced random testing of fuel pumps across four districts, including Thiruvananthapuram and Ernakulam, to verify compliance with national fuel standards and ensure consumer safety.
whyItIsViral: The story has reached a viral score of 61/100, driven by its rapid development across multiple major media outlets and the public health implications regarding fuel quality.
